result.topic_en: Scattered calculations on characteristics: tables of 0/1 arrays labelled a–f (half-period characteristics, likely for theta functions), even/odd (gerade/ungerade) classification of characteristics p+4m etc., a line-configuration sketch, some algebraic identities with square roots and an invariant-like expression in a,b,c,d,e.
